provider: Eurostat web services (SDMX 2.1 and Statistics API)

free_tier.stated: The whole Eurostat database is reachable through 'SDMX 2.1 web services' and the 'Eurostat statistics web services'; datasets are updated twice a day at 11:00 and 23:00 CET.
free_tier.notes: No key, account or allowance is mentioned on the web-services page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: JSON-stat, SDMX-ML or TSV per query. A single-series query measured 2,949 bytes; a whole dataset is a larger query, not a larger object.

retention.stated: 'The Eurostat database always contains the latest version of the datasets, meaning that there is no versioning or documentation of past versions of the data.' A revision overwrites.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered; no authentication at the transport level.

tooling: curl/python-requests; eurostat and pandasdmx python packages; the query builder on the site generates the URL.
chaining: The EU-level counterpart to World Bank indicators; the two overlap on national accounts and trade, so a reconciliation step needs both rather than either.

limits.value: none published; two anonymous queries returned 200 here with no throttling headers

limits_note: The legacy bulk download listing is gone: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/estat-navtree-portlet-prod/BulkDownloadListing?file=data/nama_10_gdp.tsv.gz returned 404 on 2026-10-23, so the only verified path is the per-query API.
binding_note: Each query returns kilobytes, so 1 TiB is millions of calls; with no published limit and no bulk file verified, the call rate decides the day's bytes.

identity_cost.detail: No key and no account: both queries returned 200 to an anonymous client.

reliability_note: No versioning: a revision replaces the number in place, so a client that re-runs a query a month later can silently get different data for the same period.
confidence_note: Two API responses were measured with byte counts and the web-services page was read.

evidence.proved: SDMX 2.1 and Statistics web services; 'no versioning or documentation of past versions'; twice-daily update at 11:00 and 23:00 CET
404 - the legacy bulk TSV listing did not answer

notes: Caveat is bulk: the service is unlimited and free but ships data in small JSON-stat responses, and the old bulk file endpoint is dead. A full Eurostat mirror is millions of queries, which is slow rather than blocked.
